d: Our leading healthcare facility is seeking an experienced Specialist Rheumatologist to diagnose, treat, and manage patients with autoimmune, inflammatory, and musculoskeletal disorders. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in managing complex rheumatological conditions, immunological disorders, and chronic inflammatory diseases.
q: MBBS or equivalent internationally recognized primary medical qualification
Relevant Master's degree, postgraduate specialist qualification, fellowship, or equivalent internationally recognized qualification in Rheumatology
Additional fellowship or advanced specialist training in Rheumatology is an advantage
Minimum 3 years of post-specialization clinical experience preferred
Strong experience in managing autoimmune, inflammatory, and musculoskeletal disorders
Experience with biologic therapies, immunosuppressive treatments, and advanced rheumatological procedures is an advantage
Excellent clinical judgment, communication, and patient-management skills
r: li
Diagnose and manage a wide range of rheumatological and autoimmune conditions
li
Treat conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, ankylosing spondylitis, psoriatic arthritis, gout, and vasculitis
li
Conduct comprehensive clinical assessments and develop individualized treatment plans
li
Manage patients with complex inflammatory and connective tissue disorders
li
Prescribe and monitor disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs), biologic therapies, and immunosuppressive treatments
li
Perform and interpret relevant diagnostic investigations, including autoimmune panels, inflammatory markers, and joint imaging
li
Provide joint aspiration and intra-articular injections where qualified
li
Monitor disease progression, treatment response, and medication-related complications
li
Collaborate with orthopaedic surgeons, dermatologists, nephrologists, physiotherapists, and other specialists
li
Counsel patients on disease management, lifestyle modifications, and long-term treatment plans
li
Maintain accurate medical records and ensure high standards of patient care
